environment: Single API app.inject process; local Docker PostgreSQL 17, temporary Redis; synthetic metadata and auth; no live provider calls; burst requests, not sustained capacity. Cold chart concurrency is bounded and may return 503. Query durations measure execution after pool acquisition; peakPoolWaiting records queue depth.

socketEvidence.measurement: In-process WebSocket gateway, synthetic committed revision invalidations; latency includes SQL update, excludes app rendering and device network. Client 60-second reconciliation implies 300 private resource reads/minute for 100 idle Captains versus 3600 previously; that client estimate is not a sustained device measurement.
